name: Brother Joshua
summary: At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Brother Joshua guides those who come to learn the ways of the Holy Light. He trains novice priests to heal wounds and strengthen their allies.

sections.title: A Mentor in the Cathedral
sections.body: Brother Joshua waits near the main altar in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. As a priest of the Church of the Holy Light, he teaches new servants of the faith to heal, raise protective wards, and focus their minds to commune with the Light. Young human priests beginning their service to the Alliance find one of their first guides in him.

faq.answer: Brother Joshua is a human priest and trainer of the Church of the Holy Light. In Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, he teaches aspiring priests their spells, rituals, and sacred duties.

faq.q: Where can I find Brother Joshua?
faq.answer: Brother Joshua waits near the high altar toward the back of the Cathedral of Light, in Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.
Brother Joshua teaches priests new ranks of divine and restorative spells. He can also reset their spiritual talents.

angles.text: As a priest, you can study the Holy Light with Brother Joshua in Stormwind. As you advance, he teaches you new prayers and disciplines.
As an Alliance member, you can find Joshua in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, at the heart of your kingdom.
